https://business-review.eu/investments/m.text: MOOV Leasing secures EUR 187 million syndicated credit facility from five banks MOOV Leasing announces the signing of a new syndicated credit facility worth 187 million euro, one of the most significant syndicated financings granted to an entrepreneurial company in Romania’s operational leasing sector. The new facility will support the company’s next stage of development, expanding access to operational leasing for SMEs and launching products dedicated to individual customers. The facility refinances the 110 million euro syndicated loan contracted by the company last year and increases MOOV’s financing capacity by more than 70%. This development confirms the banks’ confidence in the company’s business model, operational performance, and the outlook for Romania’s mobility market. The transaction was coordinated by UniCredit Bank, Banca Transilvania and Raiffeisen Bank , acting as Global Coordinators , Mandated Lead Arrangers (MLAs) and Co-Documentation Agents alongside ING Bank N.V. Amsterdam – Bucharest Branch and Exim Banca Românească , acting as Mandated Lead Arranger s. As part of the transaction, UniCredit SpA also acted as ESG Coordinator , Banca Transilvania as Facility Agent, and Raiffeisen Bank as Security Agent . Sustain LCM Finance , founded by Grația Annamaria Popescu , assisted MOOV in structuring and coordinating this syndicated financing, which also includes a sustainability-linked feature (SLL), providing specialized debt syndication advisory services throughout the entire syndication process. Read more about Filip & Company assists a syndicate of five banks in arranging a EUR 187 million sustainability-linked loan for MOOV Leasing read more The facility is structured as a Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) , a mechanism through which certain financing terms are linked to the achievement of environmental and social sustainability targets undertaken by the company. This structure reflects MOOV’s commitment to integrating ESG principles into its business development and to building a responsible growth model aligned with European best practices. Capital for the next stage of development The new facility will enable the company to accelerate the implementation of its growth strategy along three main directions: Accelerating SME financing by expanding access to modern and flexible mobility solutions; Launching operational leasing for individuals, offering retail customers a simple and predictable alternative to traditional car purchasing; Expanding the partner ecosystem by developing collaboration with importers and national car dealer networks, diversifying the offering available through the MOOV platform. Through this financing, the company is strengthening its capacity to respond to a market undergoing accelerated transformation, in which mobility is increasingly seen as a service, and vehicle usage is gaining ground over vehicle ownership. MOOV Leasing maintains its rapid growth Founded in 2022, MOOV is one of the fastest-growing companies in the Romanian operational leasing and mobility services market. The company operates through its proprietary digital platform, accessible both online and at partner dealer showrooms across the country, which simplifies the entire process, from vehicle selection to contract signing and management. In 2025, MOOV reported revenue of RON 189.9 million , more than double that of the previous year, while total assets reached RON 535.8 million , reflecting the company’s rapid growth and the consolidation of its market position. Founders’ statement Mircea Dihel and Bogdan Speteanu , founders of MOOV Leasing: “The signing of this syndicated facility marks another important milestone in MOOV’s development. Increasing the financing ceiling from EUR 110 million to EUR 187 million confirms the confidence our banking partners place in our business model, execution capability, and the results we have achieved in recent years. The new facility gives us the resources needed to continue the accelerated development of the SME segment, as well as to take a natural step toward operational leasing for individuals. We aim to make access to mobility simpler, more transparent, and fully digital, offering customers a modern alternative to traditional car purchasing. At the same time, we will continue expanding our national partner network and developing the technology platform that underpins our business model.” Lenders’ statements Roxana Bujor, Executive Director Corporate, UniCredit Bank: “We are pleased to support MOOV as it embarks on its next phase of growth through a syndicated facility that reflects the company’s strong performance and significant growth potential, as well as the banking community’s confidence in its strategy. The substantial increase in financing compared with the previous facility underscores MOOV’s ability to develop a competitive and scalable business model in a rapidly evolving mobility market. By incorporating a sustainability-linked component, the transaction also reinforces MOOV’s commitment to responsible long-term growth and to embedding ESG objectives into its development strategy.” Cosmin Calin , Deputy CEO, Large Corporate, Banca Transilvania: “ Through this financing, we are supporting the growth of a major player in operational leasing and mobility solutions — a company that combines sustainable growth with operational excellence. We believe in business models that generate long-term value, help reduce environmental impact, and support the transition to a greener economy. This transaction reaffirms Banca Transilvania’s commitment to supporting innovative companies that integrate sustainability principles into their development strategy and contribute to building a more responsible future. ” Alin Neacșu , Executive Director, Large Corporates, Raiffeisen Bank: “Raiffeisen Bank has supported MOOV’s development since its early stages, and we are pleased to continue this partnership by participating in the new syndicated financing. Our role as coordinator of the syndicate reflects our long-standing commitment to MOOV and our confidence in its strategy and growth potential. This transaction demonstrates the banking market’s capacity to support Romanian companies with solid business models and long-term growth ambitions .” Statement by Sustain LCM Finance Grația Annamaria Popescu, Founder & CEO, Sustain LCM Finance : “ We are pleased to continue our collaboration with MOOV by providing structuring, negotiation, and coordination services for this syndicated financing with a sustainability component, which represents a further step in its development strategy. We are seeing growing interest from companies in sustainable syndicated financings — these instruments offer flexibility, access to capital, and create long-term value. This transaction also highlights the importance of specialized debt advisory services in such complex financings, as well as close and responsible collaboration among all parties involved .” Legal advisors Legal advice on the transaction was provided by Filip & Company , for the lenders’ consortium, and by Stoica, Popa & Asociații , for MOOV.
